excerpt: Internal usage controls: Automated detection as described above will also apply for internal usage within Anthropic or its distribution partners.
paraphrase: The automated detection measures also apply to internal usage by Anthropic and its distribution partners.

context_stem: Internal usage controls: Automated detection as described above will also apply for internal usage...
excerpt: For internal usage (e.g. red-teaming, RL training, or other R&D activities), generated outputs and corresponding inputs are also logged and retained for at least 30 days for all internal use, including when used for training.
paraphrase: Internal usage inputs and outputs, including for red-teaming, RL training or R&D, are logged and retained for at least 30 days.

context_stem: Internal usage controls: Automated detection as described above will also apply for internal usage...
excerpt: These logs are monitored for abnormal activity, including harmful use or unexpected attempts by AI systems to take real-world actions. Alarms are treated seriously and responded to promptly.
paraphrase: Logs are monitored for abnormal activity such as harmful use or AI attempts at real-world actions, with alarms treated seriously and addressed promptly.

excerpt: Tiered access: In limited cases, models with capabilities relevant to catastrophic harm may be made available to a select group of vetted users with a legitimate and beneficial use-case that cannot be separated from dangerous capabilities, and only if such access can be granted safely and with sufficient oversight.
paraphrase: In limited cases, models with catastrophic-harm-relevant capabilities may be provided to vetted users with legitimate uses that can't be separated from the dangerous capability, if safe and sufficiently overseen.

context_stem: Tiered access: In limited cases, models with capabilities relevant to catastrophic harm may be made available...
excerpt: For example, potentially harmful biology capabilities that could be used for cancer research might be made available to a small group of vetted researchers at organizations that commit to strong, well defined, and thoroughly vetted security and internal controls.
paraphrase: For example, harmful biology capabilities usable for cancer research might be given to vetted researchers at organizations with strong, vetted security controls.

excerpt: Vulnerability and incident disclosure: Engage in a vulnerability and incident disclosure process with other labs (subject to security or legal constraints) that covers red-teaming results, national security threats, and autonomous replication threats.
paraphrase: Anthropic will engage in vulnerability and incident disclosure with other labs, covering red-teaming results and national security/autonomous replication threats, subject to constraints.

excerpt: Rapid response to model vulnerabilities: When informed of a newly discovered model vulnerability enabling catastrophic harm (e.g. a jailbreak or a detection failure), we commit to mitigate or patch it promptly (e.g. 50% of the time in which catastrophic harm could realistically occur).
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to promptly mitigating or patching newly discovered vulnerabilities enabling catastrophic harm, within roughly 50% of the time such harm could realistically occur.
stated_bar: 50% of the time in which catastrophic harm could realistically occur

context_stem: Rapid response to model vulnerabilities: When informed of a newly discovered model vulnerability...
excerpt: As part of this, Anthropic will maintain a publicly available channel for privately reporting model vulnerabilities.
paraphrase: Anthropic will maintain a public channel for privately reporting model vulnerabilities.

excerpt: The ASLs specify what has to be true substantively of our models and our security to allow safe training and deployment of those models. To ensure this system is implemented in a transparent and trustworthy manner, we additionally make the following procedural commitments.
paraphrase: The ASL system defines substantive requirements for safe training and deployment; procedural commitments below ensure transparent, trustworthy implementation.

excerpt: These commitments apply at all ASLs but might be modified or strengthened in the future:
paraphrase: These procedural commitments apply at every ASL level, though they may be modified or strengthened later.

excerpt: Follow an "Update Process" for this document, including approval by the board of directors, following consultation with the Long-Term Benefit Trust (LTBT). Any updates will be noted and reflected in this document before they are implemented.
paraphrase: Updates to the document follow a formal process requiring board approval after consultation with the LTBT, and are recorded before implementation.
